Not needed on the advance path. `closeout commit` requires exactly one of --run-dir or --no-run --reason (deskops/cli/commands/closeout.py:44-52); advance needs neither.

Closeout needs status='ready_for_testing' and has(closeout_evidence_verified) (desk/lifecycle/closeout-task_completes.md:5); testing->closeout needs nonempty(validation). No clean-worktree check, but a commit needs a staged change.
No other guard: the sole branch is `if head_subject.startswith(f"closeout: {task_id}")` (deskops/operations.py:1123); there is no run-dir or other condition.
Scope already says one regression test; no positive-path test is required.
Generic environment concern; no git version is pinned in the repo.
Implementation path and Resolved Decisions already permit raw git; the `_git` helper (tests/test_lifecycle_end_to_end.py:16) commits fixtures directly.
